subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “He had forgotten to turn off a medicine reminder.”?
options: One morning, the discipline teacher stopped him at the gate.
He also stopped losing homework because he knew where things were.
She raised her hand, but the teacher had no extra ruler.
The teacher stopped the alarm and allowed the test to continue.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「One morning, the discipline teacher stopped him at the gate.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「He also stopped losing homework because he knew where things were.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「She raised her hand, but the teacher had no extra ruler.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「He had forgotten to turn off a medicine reminder. The teacher stopped the alarm and allowed the test to continue.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「He had forgotten to turn off a medicine reminder. The teacher stopped the alarm and allowed the test to continue.」，答案為「The teacher stopped the alarm and allowed the test to continue.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The teacher stopped the alarm and allowed the test to continue.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
